ITEM 1 | Scrambled mass of pale yellow-to-golden curds, soft and crumbly with small clumps and visible wet-looking sheen, spread across the right half of the plate in an irregular mound about 12 cm by 9 cm, roughly 1.5 cm tall at its thickest, no browning or char | 150
ITEM 2 | Halved and sliced red strawberries, glossy bright red with white core areas, a whole half and several wedge slices clustered at the lower left of the plate, each piece about 3 to 4 cm long, moist surface | 60
ITEM 3 | Whole blackberries, dark purple-black with glossy small drupelets, two berries about 2 cm across sitting near the strawberries at the lower left | 15
ITEM 4 | Whole raspberries, bright red with soft rounded drupelet texture, three to four small berries about 1.5 cm across scattered among the strawberries and blackberries | 10
ITEM 5 | Thin pinkish-red smear and streaks, wet and translucent, across the upper left of the plate surface, likely fruit juice residue, flat and less than 1 mm thick | 5
